item.coloph: dran pa nam mkha'i (mkhas) chu pho rta yi lo la dam bcas nas sbas pa'o/ mang mkhar lcags 'phrang du gter du sbas/ phyi rabs thon pa'i smon lam gdab/ u tra sig u ya/ ag tham/ de nas dpon gsas khyung rgod rtsal gyi gter ma'o/ dpon gsas khyung rgod rtsal gyis rim gyi brgyud nas/ bru ston nyi ma rgyal mtshan la brgyud/ des rta sgo tshul khrims ye shes la brgyud/ des rtsa ba'i bla ma la rim gyis brgyud nas/ da lta bdag gis bkod pa'o//
